import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    a = data[1:1+n]
    positions = {}
    for idx, v in enumerate(a):
        positions.setdefault(v, []).append(idx)
    total = 0
    for v, pos in positions.items():
        cnt = 0
        sumq = 0
        for t, p in enumerate(pos):
            q = p - t
            total += q * cnt - sumq
            cnt += 1
            sumq += q
    print(total)

from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    a = data[1:1+n]
    cnt = defaultdict(int)
    sumq = defaultdict(int)
    total = 0
    for p in range(n):
        v = a[p]
        # q = p - (number of earlier occurrences of v)
        c = cnt[v]
        q = p - c
        total += c * q - sumq[v]
        sumq[v] += q
        cnt[v] = c + 1
    print(total)

def main():

    n = int(data[0])
    a = data[1:1+n]
    pos = {}
    for idx in range(n):
        v = a[idx]
        if v not in pos:
            pos[v] = []
        pos[v].append(idx + 1)
    ans = 0
    for v, plist in pos.items():
        s = 0  # sum of previous q values
        for b, p in enumerate(plist):
            q = p - b
            ans += b * q - s
            s += q
    print(ans)
